stories.title: PCA — Still One Swing Away
stories.angle: PCA enters Sept 6 at 39 HR / 33 SB (SB count updated from Sept 4 box score). He went 1-for-3 on Sept 5 — no HR, no SB; Cubs won 6-5. Needs 1 HR and 7 SB in ~22 games. 40-40 club has 6 members in 130+ years: Canseco (1988), Bonds (1996), ARod (1998), Soriano (2006), Acuña (2023), Ohtani. Cubs in WC1.

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
**Text Post 1** [9:00 AM]
Pete Crow-Armstrong: 39 HR. 33 SB. ⚾

One home run. The 40-40 club has had 6 members in the history of baseball.

22 games left. He's right there.

#Cubs #ForeverCubs

stories.title: Misiorowski — Rematch at Wrigley
stories.angle: After his first rough start of 2026 (Sept 3 vs Cubs: 5ER/4BB/4IP, ending his 26-start ≤3 ER streak), Brewers gave him extra rest. Next start Sept 7 or 8 at Wrigley — rematch vs same Cubs team. ERA: 1.97. NL Cy Young frontrunner. Redemption + Brewers playoff stakes.

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
**Text Post 1** [10:00 AM]
26 straight starts. Three earned runs or fewer every time.

Then the Cubs happened. 5 ER. 4 walks. 4 innings.

Now he gets to go back to Wrigley. Same lineup. Same park. Biggest start of his season. #Brewers

article.headline: The Cubs Got to Him First. Now Misiorowski Goes Back to Wrigley.

stories.title: Yordan Alvarez — Triple Crown Hanging by a Thread
stories.angle: Alvarez at .317 BA / 37 HR / 94 RBI entering Sept 6. All three AL category leads contested: Caminero tied at 37 HR, Alonso tied at 94 RBI, Simpson 5 pts back (.312) in BA. Last AL Triple Crown: Cabrera 2012. ~22 games left.

22 games. Last AL Triple Crown: Cabrera, 2012. #Astros

stories.title: Ohtani — Day 3 Out, October in Question
stories.angle: Ohtani held out of Saturday lineup — 3rd consecutive game missed. Not on IL. Dave Roberts: "Hopeful. I wouldn't say confident, but hopeful." Left knee + right bicep + neck. Context: .137 avg / 7-for-51 / 20K since Aug 18 before the absence.

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
**Text Post 1** [2:00 PM]
Three straight games. Still no timetable. 🚨

Roberts: "Hopeful. I wouldn't say confident, but hopeful."

Left knee. Right bicep. Neck.

Ohtani isn't on the IL — but he's not playing. October is 6 weeks away. #Dodgers

stories.title: NL Wild Card — The Last 22 Games
stories.angle: Cubs WC1 (~0.5 ahead of Phillies WC2). D-backs holding WC3. Padres 0.5 back. Cardinals at 71-72 at Colorado today. ~22-23 games remaining. WC3 is the only spot still being decided.

x_posts.text:

22 games left in the NL Wild Card race. 📊

Cubs: WC1. Phillies: WC2. D-backs: WC3.
Padres: 0.5 back. Cardinals: 71-72, further back.

That third spot is all that's left to decide. #MLB
